company.name: Town
company.shortDescription: Town is a personal AI assistant that manages the inbox, schedules meetings, and takes care of various tasks in the background.
company.description: Town provides an AI assistant platform that learns from a user's existing work patterns, communications, tasks, and workflows to help manage and complete day-to-day activities. The platform connects with workplace tools such as email, calendars, documents, messaging applications, customer relationship management systems, project management software, and databases. Its AI assistants can draft emails, prepare meeting briefings, organize schedules, conduct research, monitor tasks, and automate recurring workflows based on how individual users work. Town also supports team collaboration by allowing assistants to operate across shared business tools and data sources through a wide range of integrations. The platform emphasizes personalized assistance, workflow automation, and task execution within the applications that users already use.
